description: Master-detail settings shell with a 280px persistent sidebar on iPad and a collapsible list-then-detail pattern on iPhone.

sections.description: Array of navigation items with shape { key, icon, label, badge }

activeSectionKey.description: Key of the currently active settings section

onSectionPress.description: Callback when a sidebar nav item is tapped

searchQuery.description: Current value of the sidebar search input

onSearchChange.description: Callback when the sidebar search input changes

children.description: Content rendered in the right detail pane

anatomy: sidebar (width 280 fixed iPad, full-width collapsed iPhone)
nav-item-row (height 44, label body w500, active-indicator 3px left border coral-blossom)
role-denied-badge (lock icon inline on restricted items)
